Approve Unverified Tool?

Unverified Tool wants to use your mailbox. Name given by the app, not verified.

After you decide, you are sent back to tool.example.com.

What it may read

Looking only; nothing is changed.

Also allow

The app did not ask for these. Tick any you want it to have.

What it may read

Looking only; nothing is changed.

What it may change

Changes your mail, labels and contacts, but never sends or deletes.

Sending and deleting

These have the most effect, so each can wait for your approval before it happens.

Each request waits for you to approve or deny it here. Unanswered requests are denied after 24 hours.

Sending and deleting together

Only needed if you allow both sending and deleting. An app with both can mail anyone as you and then remove the trace.
